next_step: Cost-optimization workshop scheduled; confirm Dedicated sizing & reserved pricing
notes:
Lead: Maya (AE) — mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics/assistant). Evaluating Hosted API first for fast rollout, then Dedicated for predictable throughput once POC proves unit economics.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-11-03: Initial inbound via docs request; quick qualification call (Maya). Product -> realtime/assistant + embeddings for search.
- 2026-01-12: Hosted API demo (PRD walkthrough). Fireflies: ff-2026-02-18-ll-demo-3891 transcript + key timestamps.
- 2026-02-22: Technical deep-dive with Diego (SE) — provided model latency profiles and token-cost breakdown. Gmail thread: thread-CA+lat-1123-demo.
- 2026-03-01: POC kickoff: ingest 5M docs, run 100k embedding queries/day, chat pilot with ~150 active DAUs.
- 2026-03-05: First POC results: latency ok for low-concurrency; cost higher than expectations at default sampling/batch. Created INF-1347 to track missing KV-cache behavior in our SDK.

Requirements & constraints (customer-specified):
- Workloads: chat-first product assistant (live support + proactive suggestions), semantic search over product docs, summarization of long threads.
- Target latency: p95 <= 200ms for embeddings lookup; p95 < 150ms for short chat responses; some flows require sub-100ms for UI feel.
- Throughput: baseline 100k embeddings/day, burst to 300k/day during releases. Chat concurrency target: 200 concurrent sessions.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high — unit economics must show < $0.02 per useful end-user session for chat.
- Model preferences: open-models preferred (cost & control) but willing to use Redwood-verified curated variants. Need routing that falls back to cheaper quantized variant under capacity pressure.
- Routing/fallback: policy-based routing (latency first for Pro tier users, cost-first for internal/training traffic).
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance required for enterprise customers, audit logs, KMS for key management, retention controls for user data. Prefer residency in us-east region.

What we've offered / POC focus:
- Hosted API to stand up pilot quickly; sample token breakdown and per-route dashboards shipped to them.
- POC tests included: batching tests (varying batch sizes), cache priming for common prefix prompts, and a quantization profile trial on a 7B model variant to measure quality drop vs cost.
- Instrumented unit-econ dashboard: tokens-per-session, inferred accuracy delta, cost-per-1000-tokens, and projected monthly run-rate at 100k embeddings/day.

Cost-optimization workshop (next week):
- Agenda scoped: 1) Traffic shape analysis (they provided sample traces), 2) Batching strategy recommendations — dynamic batching windows and concurrency knobs, 3) Prefix/KV caching policies and eviction strategies for high-qps embeddings, 4) Quantization profile options (4-bit vs 8-bit mixed) with quality regression thresholds, 5) Dedicated reserved sizing options and price examples for 6/12/24-month commits, 6) Walk through unit-economics model with sensitivity analysis.
- Expected attendees: CTO (A. Holden), Head of Infra (S. Park), Product Lead (N. Rao), Maya, Diego.
- Goals: find a configuration where Hosted POC demonstrates < $0.015 per chat session with >95% quality retention; if yes, move to Dedicated sizing + reserved pricing.

Quotes / verbal notes:
- CTO: "We love the dev DX on Hosted, but need a clear path to bring cost down for product scale. Show me the math."
- Product Lead: "If we can get predictable unit costs we can enable beta to 10k users."
